messages:
Iris: quick audit result  found scattered examples still using function_call and a couple of parser-unfriendly top-level arrays. proposing a small three-step plan: 1) redirects only PR, 2) snippet migrations + compact-envelope canonical page, 3) add docs-lint warn-rule then flip to fail after 7 days.

Cal: +1. please drop the grep output in the issue. i'll take redirects.

Iris: grep and short list posted: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/1301. hotspots: /docs/guides/tool-calling/, /docs/examples/, /docs/reference/parsers/. two external blog posts reference old example slugs.

Jun: i'll handle snippet migrations. plan for examples: show before/after in both py/ts, include a tools manifest example for TS, and add a tiny compatibility shim for older SDKs. also add a short guardrails section about avoiding union-of-arrays at top-level.

CI-Bot: automated: preliminary linkcheck found 6 broken links (full list attached to issue artifact).

Cal: opening PR A (redirects only) to move old pages to /docs/deprecated-examples/ and add redirect stubs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6001. keeping PR small so preview is quick.

Jun: drafting PR B with snippet changes and canonical compact-envelope at /docs/reference/parsers/compact-envelope-v3.md. sample compact envelope (to be formatted on page):
```json
{
  "envelope": {
    "tool_call": {"name": "summarize", "args": {"text": "..."}},
    "output_schema": {"$schema_version": "v3", "type": "object", "properties": {"summary": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["summary"]}
  }
}
```
This shows the versioned schema key so parser behavior is explicit.

Iris: love the schema versioning callout. also add a short parser-fallback sentence: "parser order: schema v3 -> compact-envelope -> heuristic heuristics". Keep migration note in /docs/migration.md to 3 lines pointing to the v3 page and SDK snippets.

Jun: TS manifest snippet idea:
```ts
// tools/manifest.ts
export const tools = [summarize];
// usage
const resp = await client.chat.completions.create({ model: 'x', tools: tools });
```
and a compatibility shim note for older clients that still accept function_call.

Cal: PR A merged (redirects live). preview passed. moved files to /docs/deprecated-examples/ with short deprecation notes.

CI-Bot: automated: docs preview for PR B built: https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.io/preview/6002. linkcheck reports attached.

Jun: PR B opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6002  contains py/ts before-after examples, compact-envelope-v3 page, TS manifest example, and a 3-line migration note in /docs/migration.md. requesting reviews from @Iris and @Cal.

Iris: reviewed and left a small nit about wording on the shim (call it "temporary compatibility shim" and recommend upgrading SDKs). also suggested adding a one-liner in compact-envelope page about preferring explicit property types.

Jun: addressed nits, added guardrail bullet, and pushed updates. Docs preview is green.

DocsBot: automated: merged PR 6002. post-merge linkcheck ran and shows no remaining broken links in affected areas.

Iris: next step: add docs-lint rule to warn on literal "function_call" in examples (warn-only for 7 days, then flip to fail). who can own that?

Cal: i can add the linter change as a warn-mode check and schedule the flip. will open PR C for the linter.

Cal: PR C opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6005  adds a docs-lint rule (warn-only) that flags literal function_call in code blocks. will flip after 7 days.

CI-Bot: automated: PR C preview passed. docs-lint added as warn.

Iris: thanks team  this keeps the migration low-risk and gives teams time to update SDKs and external links. closing thread unless more regressions crop up. :rocket:
